items.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
items.description_zh: 人工智能编码代理的上下文窗口优化。沙盒工具输出（减少98 ％ ） ，保持会话内存，并通过MCP +钩子在17个平台上强制路由。
为您的代理商提供CAD超能力。

items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.description_zh: 座席线束性能优化系统。Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor等的技能、本能、记忆、安全和研究优先开发。

items.description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
items.description_zh: 更智能、自托管的人工智能助手—多用户、多代理。

items.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
items.description_zh: 每个座席跨会话的持久上下文 – 捕获座席在会话期间所做的所有操作，使用 AI 对其进行压缩，并将相关上下文注入到未来的会话中。适用于 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等

items.description: A terminal window manager that knows what your agents are doing. Tiling panes, workspaces, sessions that survive restarts, and one Inbox for every coding agent. Official only at tuios.dev and this repo. tuios has no X/Twitter account.
items.description_zh: 终端窗口管理器知道您的代理正在做什么。平铺窗格、工作区、重新启动后仍保留的会话以及每个编码代理的一个收件箱。仅限 tuios.dev 和此存储库的官方版本。 tuios 没有 X/Twitter 帐户。
